usedFor: HubSpot holds your deals and companies, and Slack is where the team talks. When “When a deal is created or updated” fires in HubSpot, “Send Interactive Message” in Slack can post it with buttons.

bestTemplate.name: “When a deal is created or updated” in HubSpot, then “Send Interactive Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Buttons or a form let the team approve or answer in place, which a plain post cannot. Deals are what the team most often needs to act on.

watchOut: Both HubSpot triggers are polling, and the deal one fires on updates as well as new deals, so one deal can post more than once. An automation's post to a Slack channel also waits for your approval today.
